title: AppHangB1 Stopped responding and was closed
author: maisondasilva

judgment.rationale: The reporter has narrowed the recurring AppHangB1 shutdown to FancyZones being enabled, but ProcDump monitoring changes the behavior and no hang dump exists. A current minimal FancyZones-only reproduction and non-invasive trace are still needed.
evidence: The original 0.88.0 report includes an AppHangB1 signature and report archive.
The hang recurs without monitoring and can terminate explorer.exe at the same time.
ProcDump monitoring prevents the process from terminating, so it has not captured the failure.
The reporter says disabling FancyZones stops the unexpected closures.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current stable minimal FancyZones reproduction, configuration, and Windows hang/event evidence without relying solely on ProcDump.

fix_assessment.rationale: FancyZones is now implicated, but the triggering feature and blocked thread are not identified.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys intermittently stops responding or closes with AppHangB1; disabling FancyZones reportedly prevents it, while ProcDump monitoring masks the failure.
known_information: The issue is intermittent but persistent.
FancyZones disablement is the strongest current isolation result.
inferences: Timing changes from monitoring may suppress a race or watchdog condition.
issue_context.analysis: The next evidence should isolate FancyZones configuration and use Windows-generated hang data that does not materially alter process timing.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: The minimal FancyZones configuration that still reproduces on current stable.
information_gaps.why_needed: FancyZones contains multiple hooks and layout behaviors.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Enable only FancyZones, use a default layout, and record the foreground action before failure.

information_gaps.information: Current Windows Reliability Monitor/Event Viewer entries and /bugreport.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Capture the event and report after an unmonitored failure.

actions.label: Request focused FancyZones hang evidence
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body:
Thanks for isolating the unexpected closures to FancyZones while noting that ProcDump changes the behavior. Please provide:
1. A current-stable minimal setup with only FancyZones enabled, the selected layout, and the last foreground action before failure.
2. The matching Reliability Monitor or Event Viewer AppHang entry, whether Explorer terminated too, and a `/bugreport` captured after an unmonitored failure.
